edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the recipient of _safeMint in the mintAlto loop.
msg.sender is passed as the recipient of _safeMint in the mintAltoCap loop.
msg.sender receives the accumulated ETH balance in withdrawAlto.
msg.sender is the target of the low-level transfer call performed in withdrawAlto.
block.timestamp initializes safPriceTimestamp in the constructor.
Price rebase condition depends on block.timestamp, making mint cost miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is used as entropy in the pseudo-random generator.
safPrice is read to validate msg.value and is reassigned during rebase in mintAlto.
nextSafPrice is read and updated inside the mintAlto rebase branch.
priceStep is used to compute nextSafPrice from totalSupply in mintAlto.
relaunchGap is subtracted from totalSupply when computing nextSafPrice.
priceCap is multiplied by numberOfNfts to require exact payment in mintAltoCap.
The saleIsActive require gates execution of mintAlto.
The saleIsActive require gates execution of mintAltoCap.
maxSupply bounds supply.add(numberOfNfts) in mintAltoCap.
maxSupply bounds the mint loop condition in airdrop.
increaseMaxSupply performs the unchecked maxSupply += _amount mutation.
The _amount parameter is consumed by increaseMaxSupply.
The _amount parameter is the addend of the unchecked maxSupply addition.
maxSupply is the mutated storage variable in the unchecked addition.
numberOfNfts drives the mint loop and msg.value validation in mintAlto.
numberOfNfts drives the mint loop and payment/supply checks in mintAltoCap.
The local supply value seeds the token ids minted in the loop.
_safeMint inside mintAlto triggers the onERC721Received callback on the recipient.
_safeMint inside mintAltoCap triggers the onERC721Received callback on the recipient.
giveaway calls _safeMint to an arbitrary owner-supplied address.
airdrop calls _safeMint to a randomly selected owner address.
restore calls _safeMint with an owner-chosen wallet.
withdrawAlto executes the msg.sender transfer before completing all state effects.
withdrawAlto performs a second transfer to a pseudo-random owner address.
airdrop invokes backToCommunity to select the mint recipient.
withdrawAlto invokes backToCommunity to select the second transfer recipient.
backToCommunity calls random() to derive the owner index.
flipSaleState inverts the saleIsActive state variable.
updatePriceStep overwrites the priceStep state variable.
updateRelaunchPrice overwrites the relaunchGap state variable.
changeTimer overwrites the safPriceLifetime state variable.
setProvenanceHash writes the ALTO_PROVENANCE state variable.
setBaseURI writes ERC721 base URI state through _setBaseURI.
Constructor assigns block.timestamp to safPriceTimestamp.
getPrice multiplies supply by priceStep when quoting the price.
getPrice subtracts relaunchGap from totalSupply.
getPrice caps the computed price at priceCap.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only exists to size the mint loop inside mintAlto and should be folded into that function node.
The parameter only drives the mint loop and payment checks of mintAltoCap and is absorbed by that function node.
